output.explanation: NIG-DE invoiced EUR 5,040.00 (NIG-DE:5100873302, RE-2026-000646) for the secondment of Grace Smith. NIG-SA booked EUR 4,788.00 (NIG-SA:ICV-SA-018807) against the same reference and counterparty, two days later and within the period. The buyer-to-seller ratio of 0.95 matches the 5% Saudi withholding tax on services, and the buyer's description says 'net of WHT 5%'; the EUR 252.00 gap equals USD 272.66 at the invoice-date rate.
output.recommended_action: NIG-DE should obtain the Saudi WHT certificate from NIG-SA and clear the EUR 252.00 residual on the IC receivable to a WHT tax receivable or WHT expense account.
output.adjustment_description: In NIG-DE, debit WHT tax receivable (or WHT expense if no credit is available) EUR 252.00 and credit the IC receivable from NIG-SA EUR 252.00. This reflects the 5% withholding tax NIG-SA retained and remits to ZATCA, and it brings the IC balances into agreement at EUR 4,788.00.
